:::{#exm-reed-solomon-list-size}
#### The list size for the length-5 Reed--Solomon code

<!-- no-figure: the example is one computed number -->

Take $n = 5$, $k = 2$ and $e = 2$, as in @exm-list-decoding-reed-solomon.
The theorem gives $\binom{5}{2} / \binom{3}{2}$ as the largest list size.

```{r}
#| label: reed-solomon-list-size
choose(5, 2) / choose(3, 2)
```

The list size is a whole number, so it is at most 3.
The received word of @exm-list-decoding-reed-solomon has 2.

:::
